summary: Wheaton Precious Metals filed a Form 6-K on November 5, 2026, attaching a news release declaring its fourth quarterly cash dividend for 2026 of US$0.195 per common share, an 18% increase over the fourth-quarter 2025 declaration. The record date is November 19, 2026, with payment on or about December 3, 2026, and an ex-dividend trading date of November 19, 2026. The dividend qualifies as an eligible dividend for Canadian tax purposes. Shares under the optional Dividend Reinvestment Plan will be issued from treasury at the Average Market Price without a discount. The board noted future dividends remain at its discretion. Watch DRIP dilution and payout sustainability.
